appContext.category: fire watch and security patrol logging for security companies
appContext.summary: Phoenix Fire Watch lets fire watch and security patrol companies manage monitored properties, log patrols with live time-stamped photos and status (Clear, Follow-up, Incident), run repeating patrol timers that alert officers 5 minutes before each patrol is due, share team watch notes, and send signed PDF shift reports to property contacts. Works offline and syncs with the web dashboard.

theme.style: Near-black command-center darkness lit by controlled red ember light that matches the app's dark UI and #DC2626 alert accents. Moody and disciplined rather than chaotic, with the mood of a night shift under emergency lighting. Surfaces use smoky charcoal gradients, faint warm haze, thin glowing red lines and soft rim light. Upper areas stay deep black and calm for headlines, and the glow pools low behind the device.
